tasks.title: The Challenges for Small Mammals in the Rainforest Canopy
paras: The canopy, the upper level of the trees in the rain forest, holds a plethora of climbing mammals of moderately large size, which may include monkeys, cats, civets, and porcupines. Smaller species, including such rodents as mice and small squirrels, are not as prevalent overall in high tropical canopies as they are in most habitats globally.

Small mammals, being warm blooded, suffer hardship in the exposed and turbulent environment of the uppermost trees. Because a small body has more surface area per unit of weight than a large one of similar shape, it gains or loses heat more swiftly. Thus, in the trees, where shelter from heat and cold may be scarce and conditions may fluctuate, a small mammal may have trouble maintaining its body temperature.

Small size makes it easy to scramble among twigs and branches in the canopy for insects, flowers, or fruit, but small mammals are surpassed, in the competition for food, by large ones that have their own tactics for browsing among food-rich twigs. The weight of a gibbon hanging below a branch arches the terminal leaves down so that fruit-bearing foliage drops toward the gibbon’s face.

Small climbing animals may reach twigs readily, but it is harder for them than for large climbing animals to cross the wide gaps from one tree crown to the next. A macaque or gibbon can hurl itself farther than a mouse can. The forward movement of a small animal is seriously reduced by the air friction against the relatively large surface area of its body. Finally, for the many small mammals that supplement their insect diet with fruits or seeds, an inability to span open gaps may be problematic.

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?

options.A: The rain forest canopy offers abundant food and shelter for animals of all sizes.
options.B: Small mammals are better adapted than large mammals to survive in the rain forest canopy.
options.C: The physical challenges of the rain forest canopy limit the success of small mammals there.
options.D: All mammals in the rain forest canopy have evolved similar techniques for survival.

questions.analysis: 题型：主旨题 原文定位： 全文整体结构：第一段指出小型哺乳动物较少；第二段讲热交换难题；第三段讲觅食劣势；第四段讲跨树困难。 正确答案分析： 整篇在对比大小动物的能力，重点是小动物在 canopy 中受限于环境与身体条件。 选项分析： A 只说资源，不涉及限制； B 与原文主旨相反； D 说法过于绝对，且不符合原文差异化描述。

questions.stem: The word “supplement” in the text is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 题型：词汇题 原文定位： 第四段最后一句：“...supplement their insect diet with fruits or seeds...” 正确答案分析： “supplement with”表示“补充”，即“在已有饮食基础上再增加”。 选项分析： A control（控制）不合逻辑； B replace（替代）相反含义； C look for（寻找）并非补充动作。

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is true about the small mammals in the rain forests?

options.A: They have body shapes that are adapted to life in the canopy.
options.B: They prefer the temperature and climate of the canopy to that of other environments.
options.C: They have difficulty with the changing conditions in the canopy.
options.D: They use the trees of the canopy for shelter from heat and cold.

questions.analysis: 题型：细节题 原文定位： 第2段：“...a small mammal may have trouble maintaining its body temperature.” 正确答案分析： 指出小哺乳动物由于体型小、表面积大，难以在 canopy 中调节体温，应对变化的环境。 选项分析： A 未说是“适应”的体型； B 没有“偏好”温度的描述； D 没提到用树木避温。

questions.stem: In discussing animal size, the author indicates that

options.A: small animals require proportionately more food than larger animals do
options.B: a large animal’s size is an advantage in obtaining food in the canopy
options.C: small animals are often attacked by large animals in the rain forest
options.D: small animals and large animals are equally adept at obtaining food in the canopy

questions.analysis: 题型：推断题 原文定位： 第3段：“...but small mammals are surpassed... by large ones that have their own tactics...” 正确答案分析： 描述大型动物如何利用体重压低枝叶、用尾巴固定取果，对比强调其优势。 选项分析： A 无数量需求对比； C 无捕食关系描述； D 文中明确指出差异，不是“同样擅长”。

questions.stem: According to the passage, what makes jumping from one tree crown to another difficult for small mammals?

options.A: Their limited ability to gain momentum and use branches for propulsion
options.B: The instability of outer branches when bearing the weight of small animals
options.C: Their need to pause frequently due to low energy reserves
options.D: The dense vegetation and frequent rainfall in the canopy layer

questions.analysis: 题型：细节题 原文定位： 第4段：“The forward movement of a small animal is seriously reduced by the air friction against the relatively large surface area of its body.” 正确答案分析： 指出小动物难以借力起跳，气动力阻碍更大，因此不如大型动物能跨越树冠间隙。 选项分析： B 枝干稳定性未提及； C 未涉及能量消耗； D 没说前爪问题。
